CALAMITY-NETTLE_SHIRT.title: Nettle Shirt
CALAMITY-NETTLE_SHIRT.description: Whenever you lose HP, lose [blue]{Extra}[/blue] more. In combat, you are [gold]Sensitive[/gold].
CALAMITY-NETTLE_SHIRT.flavor: It itches, it stings, and it does not come off.
CALAMITY-CRACKED_FEMUR.title: Cracked Femur
CALAMITY-CRACKED_FEMUR.description: At the start of each combat, gain [blue]{Brittle}[/blue] [gold]Brittle[/gold].
CALAMITY-CRACKED_FEMUR.flavor: Something in the air of this place makes everything crack.
CALAMITY-LUMPY_COT.title: Lumpy Cot
CALAMITY-LUMPY_COT.description: Restore [blue]{HealReduction}%[/blue] less HP at rest sites, from [gold]Resting[/gold] or being [gold]Mended[/gold].
CALAMITY-LUMPY_COT.flavor: Every lump finds a different rib.
CALAMITY-MOTH_EATEN_PURSE.title: Moth-Eaten Purse
CALAMITY-HEAVY_PACK.title: Heavy Pack
CALAMITY-HEAVY_PACK.description: At the start of each combat, shuffle [blue]{Cards}[/blue] [gold]Dazed[/gold] into your draw pile.
CALAMITY-HEAVY_PACK.flavor: You could swear it was lighter when you found it.
CALAMITY-LEAKY_FLASK.title: Leaky Flask
CALAMITY-FLEA_RIDDEN_BLANKET.title: Flea-Ridden Blanket
CALAMITY-FLEA_RIDDEN_BLANKET.description: At the start of each combat, become [gold]Itchy[/gold]: whenever you shuffle your draw pile, lose [blue]{HpLoss}[/blue] HP.
CALAMITY-RUSTED_HINGE.title: Rusted Hinge
CALAMITY-RUSTED_HINGE.description: At the start of each combat, become [gold]Seized[/gold]: the first card you play costs [blue]1[/blue] more.
CALAMITY-RUSTED_HINGE.flavor: It always sticks when it matters.
CALAMITY-BLOODIED_SIGNPOST.title: Bloodied Signpost
CALAMITY-BLOODIED_SIGNPOST.description: Whenever you enter a [gold]?[/gold] room, lose [blue]{HpLoss}[/blue] HP.
CALAMITY-SPITEFUL_TOTEM.title: Spiteful Totem
CALAMITY-SPITEFUL_TOTEM.description: Enemies have [gold]Backlash[/gold]: whenever they lose [gold]Strength[/gold], they permanently regain [blue]{Percent}%[/blue] of it, rounded up.
CALAMITY-SPITEFUL_TOTEM.flavor: Every wound you open, it learns from.
CALAMITY-BRIAR_CROWN.title: Briar Crown
CALAMITY-BRIAR_CROWN.flavor: Worn by no one, feared by everyone.
CALAMITY-WAR_DRUM.title: War Drum
CALAMITY-MOURNING_BELL.title: Mourning Bell
CALAMITY-MOURNING_BELL.description: Enemies are [gold]Mourning[/gold]: whenever one dies, the others gain [blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold].
CALAMITY-MOURNING_BELL.flavor: It tolls for them, and they answer.
CALAMITY-MARTYRS_FUSE.title: Martyr's Fuse
CALAMITY-MARTYRS_FUSE.description: Enemies are [gold]Volatile[/gold]: whenever one dies, it deals [blue]{Damage}[/blue] damage to each player.
CALAMITY-WARDENS_SEAL.title: Warden's Seal
CALAMITY-WARDENS_SEAL.description: Elites and bosses start combat with [blue]{ArtifactPower}[/blue] [gold]Artifact[/gold].
CALAMITY-WARDENS_SEAL.flavor: Stamped, sealed, and very much awake.
CALAMITY-CROOKED_SCALE.title: Crooked Scale
CALAMITY-CROOKED_SCALE.description: Merchant prices are [blue]{Markup}%[/blue] higher for everyone.
CALAMITY-CROOKED_SCALE.flavor: Somehow it always tips their way.
CALAMITY-BRAMBLE_SIGNPOST.title: Bramble Signpost
CALAMITY-BRAMBLE_SIGNPOST.description: [gold]?[/gold] rooms are much more likely to be fights.
CALAMITY-BRAMBLE_SIGNPOST.flavor: Every path it points to has teeth.
CALAMITY-LEAD_BOOKMARK.title: Lead Bookmark
CALAMITY-LEAD_BOOKMARK.description: At the start of each combat, become [gold]Drowsy[/gold]: draw [blue]{Cards}[/blue] fewer card each turn.
CALAMITY-POLLEN_SACHET.title: Pollen Sachet
CALAMITY-POLLEN_SACHET.description: At the start of each combat, gain [blue]{Weak}[/blue] [gold]Weak[/gold].
CALAMITY-THISTLE_GRIP.title: Thistle Grip
CALAMITY-THISTLE_GRIP.description: At the start of each combat, gain [gold]Thorny Grip[/gold]: the first Attack you play each turn deals [blue]{Damage}[/blue] damage to you.
CALAMITY-THISTLE_GRIP.flavor: Gloves would help. You have none.
CALAMITY-PUFFBALL_SPORE.title: Puffball Spore
CALAMITY-PUFFBALL_SPORE.description: Enemies carry a [gold]Spore Cloud[/gold]: whenever one dies, every player gains [blue]{Weak}[/blue] [gold]Weak[/gold].
CALAMITY-IRONBARK_SAP.title: Ironbark Sap
CALAMITY-IRONBARK_SAP.flavor: It hardens on everything it touches.
CALAMITY-BLIGHTED_SEEDS.title: Blighted Seeds
CALAMITY-BLIGHTED_SEEDS.flavor: Nothing you plant will ever grow right.
CALAMITY-DAMP_POWDER_HORN.title: Damp Powder Horn
CALAMITY-DAMP_POWDER_HORN.description: At the start of each combat, become [gold]Damp[/gold]: your first Attack deals [blue]{Damp}[/blue] less damage.
CALAMITY-BILGE_BUCKET.title: Bilge Bucket
CALAMITY-BILGE_BUCKET.description: Enemies are [gold]Slimy[/gold]: their unblocked attacks add a [gold]Slimed[/gold] to the target's discard pile.
CALAMITY-BILGE_BUCKET.flavor: It's always full, and never of anything good.
CALAMITY-ROTTEN_CRATE.title: Rotten Crate
CALAMITY-CRACKED_HULL_PLANK.title: Cracked Hull Plank
CALAMITY-CRACKED_HULL_PLANK.description: After each combat, lose [blue]{MaxHp}[/blue] Max HP.
CALAMITY-CRACKED_HULL_PLANK.flavor: Slowly, surely, you are taking on water.
CALAMITY-RUSTED_BUCKLER.title: Rusted Buckler
CALAMITY-RUSTED_BUCKLER.description: At the start of each combat, become [gold]Rusted[/gold]: [gold]Block[/gold] from cards is reduced by [blue]{Block}[/blue].
CALAMITY-TINY_POUCH.title: Tiny Pouch
CALAMITY-TINY_POUCH.description: At the start of each combat, become [gold]Cramped[/gold]: your maximum hand size is [blue]{Cards}[/blue] smaller.
CALAMITY-TINY_POUCH.flavor: Room for a coin, maybe two.
CALAMITY-HIVE_NECTAR.title: Hive Nectar
CALAMITY-HIVE_NECTAR.description: Enemies share [gold]Lifeblood[/gold]: whenever one dies, the others heal half of its Max HP.
CALAMITY-DULL_WHETSTONE.title: Dull Whetstone
CALAMITY-CLOUDED_ORB.title: Clouded Orb
CALAMITY-CLOUDED_ORB.description: At the start of each combat, become [gold]Clouded[/gold]: your Powers cost [blue]{Energy}[/blue] more.
CALAMITY-CLOUDED_ORB.flavor: Nothing in it is clear anymore.
CALAMITY-TREMBLING_GAUNTLET.title: Trembling Gauntlet
CALAMITY-TREMBLING_GAUNTLET.description: At the start of each combat, discard [blue]{Cards}[/blue] random card.
CALAMITY-BLUE_SKULL.title: Blue Skull
CALAMITY-BLUE_SKULL.description: Enemies have [gold]Rage Threshold[/gold]: the first time each drops to half HP, it gains [blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold].
CALAMITY-BLUE_SKULL.flavor: Red Skull's colder twin. It works for them.
CALAMITY-IRON_MANACLE.title: Iron Manacle
CALAMITY-IRON_MANACLE.description: At the start of each combat, become [gold]Manacled[/gold]: you can play only [blue]1[/blue] Attack each turn.
CALAMITY-FROZEN_EMBER.title: Frozen Ember
CALAMITY-FROZEN_EMBER.description: At the start of each combat, become [gold]Frozen[/gold]: gain [blue]1[/blue] less Energy for [blue]{Turns}[/blue] turns.
CALAMITY-DOOM_CLOCK.title: Doom Clock
CALAMITY-DOOM_CLOCK.description: At the start of each combat, start [gold]Ticking[/gold]: from turn [blue]{StartTurn}[/blue], gain [blue]{DoomPower}[/blue] [gold]Doom[/gold] at the start of your turn.
CALAMITY-GUTTERING_BRAZIER.title: Guttering Brazier
CALAMITY-GUTTERING_BRAZIER.description: Every [blue]{Combats}[/blue] combats, choose one of your relics to [gold]Melt[/gold]; it stops working. Calamity relics and used-up relics can't be chosen.
CALAMITY-GUTTERING_BRAZIER.flavor: It burns whatever you hold dear.
CALAMITY-BALLAST_BOX.title: Ballast Box
CALAMITY-BALLAST_BOX.description: Every [blue]{Turns}[/blue] turns, add a [gold]Weight[/gold] to your deck. The count carries between combats.
CALAMITY-BALLAST_BOX.flavor: It keeps making more of itself.
CALAMITY-BOUND_LOCKET.title: Bound Locket
CALAMITY-BOUND_LOCKET.description: Whenever an ally adds a [gold]Curse[/gold] to their deck, add a copy to yours.
CALAMITY-BOUND_LOCKET.flavor: What's theirs is yours. All of it.
CALAMITY-BROKEN_GLASSES.title: Broken Glasses
CALAMITY-BROKEN_GLASSES.description: At the start of each combat, gain [gold]Blurred Vision[/gold]: cards and potions you aim at an enemy hit a random enemy instead.
CALAMITY-BROKEN_GLASSES.flavor: Was that the one you meant?
CALAMITY-HUNGRY_JAR.title: Hungry Jar
CALAMITY-HUNGRY_JAR.description: Upon pickup, add a [gold]Gnawing[/gold] to your deck.
CALAMITY-HUNGRY_JAR.flavor: It was empty when you opened it. Something got out.
CALAMITY-KUDZU_CUTTING.title: Kudzu Cutting
CALAMITY-KUDZU_CUTTING.description: Every [blue]{Combats}[/blue] combats, add a [gold]Kudzu[/gold] to your deck.
CALAMITY-KUDZU_CUTTING.flavor: Just a little sprig. For now.
CALAMITY-SOGGY_BANDOLIER.title: Soggy Bandolier
CALAMITY-SOGGY_BANDOLIER.description: At the start of each combat, become [gold]Soaked[/gold]: you can't use potions on your first turn.
CALAMITY-SMUGGLERS_PADLOCK.title: Smuggler's Padlock
CALAMITY-SMUGGLERS_PADLOCK.description: Whenever you enter a merchant, one of their services is closed: cards, potions, relics, or card removal.
CALAMITY-SHIELDBREAKER_SPIKE.title: Shieldbreaker Spike
CALAMITY-SHIELDBREAKER_SPIKE.description: Enemies are [gold]Shieldbreakers[/gold]: their attacks deal [blue]{Block}[/blue] extra damage to [gold]Block[/gold].
CALAMITY-VAKUUS_SEXTANT.title: Vakuu's Sextant
CALAMITY-VAKUUS_SEXTANT.description: [gold]Vakuu[/gold] votes on every path you take, at random.
CALAMITY-VAKUUS_SEXTANT.flavor: "This way. No, that way. Trust me."
CALAMITY-FOGBOUND_LANTERN.title: Fogbound Lantern
CALAMITY-FOGBOUND_LANTERN.description: Every player starts each combat [gold]Fogbound[/gold]: their hand is hidden until they play a card, and they can't view their deck.
CALAMITY-FOGBOUND_LANTERN.flavor: It sheds fog instead of light.
CALAMITY-TRIAL_WRIT.title: Trial Writ
CALAMITY-TRIAL_WRIT.flavor: Signed in a hand you almost recognise.
